import subprocess, re, os, json, urllib.parse

serial = "4ae24c72"
env_path = "/Users/stark/Desktop/work/RN/heals-app-rn/.env.development"
secret = None
with open(env_path) as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith("CLIENT_SECRET="):
            secret = line.split("=", 1)[1].strip()
            break
if not secret:
    raise SystemExit("missing client secret")

# last known location from dumpsys, do not print raw coords later
loc = subprocess.run(["adb", "-s", serial, "shell", "dumpsys", "location"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=40)
text = loc.stdout
coords = []
for m in re.finditer(r"last location=Location\[[^\]]* ([0-9.]+),([0-9.]+)", text):
    coords.append((float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2)), "device-last"))
if not coords:
    for m in re.finditer(r"\b([0-9]{1,2}\.[0-9]{4,}),\s*([0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{4,})\b", text):
        lat, lng = float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2))
        if -90 <= lat <= 90 and -180 <= lng <= 180:
            coords.append((lat, lng, "device-parsed"))
            break

samples = []
if coords:
    samples.append(coords[0])
else:
    samples.append((22.3193, 114.1694, "hong-kong-fallback"))

# also one known city if device coords exist, to match the ticket matrix lightly
if samples[0][2] != "hong-kong-fallback":
    samples.append((22.3193, 114.1694, "hong-kong-public"))

def call(lat, lng, label):
    latlng = f"{lat},{lng}"
    url = "https://health-passport-dev.heals.asia/api/geolocation?latlng=" + urllib.parse.quote(latlng) + "&result_type=country"
    cmd = [
        "adb", "-s", serial, "shell",
        "curl", "-sS", "-m", "25",
        "-w", "\n__HTTP__%{http_code}",
        "-H", "Accept: application/json",
        "-H", "Accept-Language: zh",
        "-H", "x-client-id: health-passport",
        "-H", f"x-client-secret: {secret}",
        url,
    ]
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=40)
    raw = proc.stdout
    err = proc.stderr.strip()
    http = None
    body = raw
    if "\n__HTTP__" in raw:
        body, http = raw.rsplit("\n__HTTP__", 1)
    summary = {
        "label": label,
        "http": http,
        "curl_exit": proc.returncode,
        "stderr": err[:300] if err else "",
    }
    try:
        data = json.loads(body)
    except Exception:
        summary["parse_error"] = True
        summary["body_prefix"] = body[:240]
        return summary
    summary["status"] = data.get("status")
    summary["error_message"] = data.get("error_message")
    results = data.get("results") or []
    summary["results_count"] = len(results)
    if results:
        comps = results[0].get("address_components") or []
        summary["long_name"] = comps[0].get("long_name") if comps else None
        summary["short_name"] = comps[0].get("short_name") if comps else None
        summary["types"] = comps[0].get("types") if comps else None
        summary["formatted_address"] = results[0].get("formatted_address")
    return summary

out = []
for lat, lng, label in samples:
    out.append(call(lat, lng, label))
print(json.dumps({"device_fix_found": bool(coords), "samples": len(samples), "results": out}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

import subprocess, re, json, urllib.parse

serial = "4ae24c72"
env_path = "/Users/stark/Desktop/work/RN/heals-app-rn/.env.development"
secret = None
with open(env_path) as f:

            break

loc = subprocess.run(["adb", "-s", serial, "shell", "dumpsys", "location"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=40)

for m in re.finditer(r"last location=Location\[(?:gps|network|fused|passive)\s+(-?[0-9.]+),(-?[0-9.]+)", loc.stdout):
    lat, lng = float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2))

        kind = "gps" if "Location[gps" in m.group(0) else "network"
        coords.append((lat, lng, kind))
        break

samples = []
if coords:
    samples.append((*coords[0], "device-last"))
samples.append((22.3193, 114.1694, "public", "hong-kong"))
samples.append((31.2304, 121.4737, "public", "shanghai"))

def call(lat, lng, label):
    latlng = f"{lat},{lng}"
    url = "https://health-passport-dev.heals.asia/api/geolocation?latlng=" + urllib.parse.quote(latlng, safe=",") + "&result_type=country"
    remote = (
        "curl -sS -m 30 -D /data/local/tmp/geo_hdr.txt -o /data/local/tmp/geo_body.json "
        "-H 'Accept: application/json' -H 'Accept-Language: zh' "
        "-H 'x-client-id: health-passport' "
        f"-H 'x-client-secret: {secret}' "
        f"'{url}'; echo __EXIT__$?"
    )
    proc = subprocess.run(["adb", "-s", serial, "shell", remote], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
    body_proc = subprocess.run(["adb", "-s", serial, "shell", "cat /data/local/tmp/geo_body.json"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
    hdr_proc = subprocess.run(["adb", "-s", serial, "shell", "head -n 1 /data/local/tmp/geo_hdr.txt"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
    subprocess.run(["adb", "-s", serial, "shell", "rm -f /data/local/tmp/geo_body.json /data/local/tmp/geo_hdr.txt"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    summary = {
        "label": label,
        "status_line": (hdr_proc.stdout or "").strip()[:80],
        "shell": (proc.stdout or "").strip()[:80],
        "stderr": (proc.stderr or "").strip()[:200],
    }
    body = body_proc.stdout.strip()
    try:
        data = json.loads(body)
    except Exception:
        summary["parse_error"] = True
        summary["body_prefix"] = body[:180]

    results = data.get("results") or []

    summary["error_message"] = data.get("error_message")
    summary["results_count"] = len(results)

        summary["types"] = comps[0].get("types") if comps else None
        summary["formatted_address"] = results[0].get("formatted_address")
    return summary

out = [call(lat, lng, label) for lat, lng, _src, label in samples]

content.text:
**dev 环境的 `/geolocation` 已经恢复。** 真机发出的请求返回 HTTP 200，Google `status` 为 `OK`，并且带有国家信息，不再是 `REQUEST_DENIED`。

[TECH-8854](https://app.clickup.com/t/8553538/TECH-8854?comment=1100750000159103) 里 Gordon Li 的评论是「google map api key 已恢复」。原先的失败形态是 HTTP 200，但响应体为 Google `REQUEST_DENIED`、`results` 为空。

我在已连接的 OPPO `PJJ110` 上，用手机自己的网络请求 dev 地址 `https://health-passport-dev.heals.asia/api/geolocation`，参数与应用一致：`result_type=country`，并带上应用拦截器里的 `x-client-id` / `x-client-secret`。当时前台是已安装的 `com.healshealthcare.healspass.dev` `1.2.3` debug 包。

| 坐标 | HTTP | status | `results[0]` 的国家 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 香港 | 200 | OK | Hong Kong（`country`） |
| 上海 | 200 | OK | China（`country`） |

这两个 `long_name` 都在应用白名单里，和 `AppContext` 写入位置时读取的字段一致。

冷启动同一次 dev 包后，日志里没有新的 `GET /geolocation`。这和票里的说明一致：加密存储里已有 `position` 时，启动不会重新定位，也不会再打这个接口。我没有清应用数据。同一次启动里出现的 401 来自 `/api/v1/provider/options`，不是 `/geolocation`。
